addMember(uint256,address).details: Reverts if `roleId` does not represent an initialized, SharedRole or if the caller is not a member of the managing role for `roleId`.

params.currency: token used to pay the final fee.

returns._0: finalFee amount due denominated in units of `currency`.

computeRegularFee(uint256,uint256,(uint2.details: The late penalty is similar to the regular fee in that is is charged per second over the period between startTime and endTime. The late penalty percentage increases over time as follows: - 0-1 week since startTime: no late penalty - 1-2 weeks since startTime: 1x late penalty percentage is applied - 2-3 weeks since startTime: 2x late penalty percentage is applied - ...

params.endTime: end time until which the fee is paid.
params.pfc: "profit from corruption", or the maximum amount of margin currency that a token sponsor could extract from the contract through corrupting the price feed in their favor.
params.startTime: defines the beginning time from which the fee is paid.

returns.latePenalty: penalty percentage, if any, for paying the fee after the deadline.
returns.regularFee: amount owed for the duration from start to end time for the given pfc.

getMember(uint256).details: Reverts if `roleId` does not represent an initialized, exclusive role.

returns._0: the address of the current ExclusiveRole member.

holdsRole(uint256,address).details: Reverts if roleId does not correspond to an initialized role.

returns._0: True if `memberToCheck` is a member of `roleId`.

payOracleFees().details: To be used by contracts whose margin currency is ETH.

payOracleFeesErc20(address,(uint256)).details: To be used if the margin currency is an ERC20 token rather than ETH.

params.amount: number of tokens to transfer. An approval for at least this amount must exist.
params.erc20Address: address of the ERC20 token used to pay the fee.

removeMember(uint256,address).details: Reverts if `roleId` does not represent an initialized, SharedRole or if the caller is not a member of the managing role for `roleId`.

params.memberToRemove: the current SharedRole member to remove.

renounceMembership(uint256).details: Reverts if the caller is not a member of the role for `roleId` or if `roleId` is not an initialized, SharedRole.

resetMember(uint256,address).details: Reverts if the caller is not a member of the managing role for `roleId` or if `roleId` is not an initialized, ExclusiveRole.

setCurrentTime(uint256).details: Will revert if not running in test mode.

params.time: timestamp to set current Tesable time to.

params.currency: defines the token currency used to pay the final fee.

params.newFixedOracleFeePerSecondPerPfc: new fee per second charged to use the oracle.

params.newWeeklyDelayFeePerSecondPerPfc: fee escalation per week of late fee payment.
